name: payment-cryptography
description: Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography Control Plane APIs manage encryption keys for use during payment-related cryptographic operations.

subcommands.name: add-key-replication-regions
subcommands.description: Adds replication Amazon Web Services Regions to an existing Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key, enabling the key to be used for cryptographic operations in additional Amazon Web Services Regions.

subcommands.name: associate-mpa-team
subcommands.description: Associates a Multi-Party Approval (MPA) team with a protected operation.

subcommands.name: create-alias
subcommands.description: Creates an alias, or a friendly name, for an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key.

subcommands.name: create-key
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key, a logical representation of a cryptographic key, that is unique in your account and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: delete-alias
subcommands.description: Deletes the alias, but doesn't affect the underlying key.

subcommands.name: delete-key
subcommands.description: Deletes the key material and metadata associated with Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Removes the resource-based policy attached to an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key.

subcommands.name: disable-default-key-replication-regions
subcommands.description: Disables Multi-Region key replication settings for the specified Amazon Web Services Regions in your Amazon Web Services account, preventing new keys from being automatically replicated to those regions.

subcommands.name: disassociate-mpa-team
subcommands.description: Removes the association between a Multi-Party Approval (MPA) team and a protected operation.

subcommands.name: enable-default-key-replication-regions
subcommands.description: Enables Multi-Region key replication settings for your Amazon Web Services account, causing new keys to be automatically replicated to the specified Amazon Web Services Regions when created.

subcommands.name: export-key
subcommands.description: Exports a key from Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography.

subcommands.name: get-alias
subcommands.description: Gets the Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key associated with the alias.

subcommands.name: get-certificate-signing-request
subcommands.description: Creates a certificate signing request (CSR) from a key pair.

subcommands.name: get-default-key-replication-regions
subcommands.description: Retrieves the list of Amazon Web Services Regions where Multi-Region key replication is currently enabled for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-key
subcommands.description: Gets the key metadata for an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key, including the immutable and mutable attributes specified when the key was created.

subcommands.name: get-mpa-team-association
subcommands.description: Returns the Multi-Party Approval (MPA) team association for a protected operation.

subcommands.name: get-parameters-for-export
subcommands.description: Gets the export token and the signing key certificate to initiate a TR-34 key export from Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography.

subcommands.name: get-parameters-for-import
subcommands.description: Gets the import token and the wrapping key certificate in PEM format (base64 encoded) to initiate a TR-34 WrappedKeyBlock or a RSA WrappedKeyCryptogram import into Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography.

subcommands.name: get-public-key-certificate
subcommands.description: Gets the public key certificate of the asymmetric key pair that exists within Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the resource-based policy attached to an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key.

subcommands.name: import-key
subcommands.description: Imports symmetric keys and public key certificates in PEM format (base64 encoded) into Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography.

subcommands.name: list-aliases
subcommands.description: Lists the aliases for all keys in the caller's Amazon Web Services account and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-keys
subcommands.description: Lists the keys in the caller's Amazon Web Services account and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for an Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches or replaces a resource-based policy on an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key.

subcommands.name: remove-key-replication-regions
subcommands.description: Removes Replication Regions from an existing Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key, disabling the key's availability for cryptographic operations in the specified Amazon Web Services Regions.

subcommands.name: restore-key
subcommands.description: Cancels a scheduled key deletion during the waiting period.

subcommands.name: start-key-usage
subcommands.description: Enables an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key, which makes it active for cryptographic operations within Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography Cross-account use: This operation supports cross-account use when the key has a resource-based policy that grants access.

subcommands.name: stop-key-usage
subcommands.description: Disables an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key, which makes it inactive within Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or edits tags on an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes a tag from an Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography key.

subcommands.name: update-alias
subcommands.description: Associates an existing Amazon Web Services Payment Cryptography alias with a different key.
